_comment: Controlled trojan-effect taxonomy for designs with no separate trojan module (NINA_DATA/FINAL-DATA corpus). Classifies the inline trojan-marker comment text (see _extract_inline_trojan_patterns in pipeline_config.py) into a category, then picks a category-appropriate taint-source fallback role instead of forcing the confidentiality key|state|plaintext|secret heuristic onto non-leakage designs. 'source_role' documents WHY that fallback signal set is the right IFT seed for this category, not just what it is.

leak_info.source_role: confidentiality source (key/state/secret) or, if absent, the trojan-region operand that stores/moves the leaked value

dos.source_role: trigger-condition operand — the signal whose value gates the malicious stall/block behavior, extracted from `if (...)` conditions inside the trojan-marker window

corruption.source_role: the legitimate data operand the trojan payload corrupts, extracted from assignment right-hand-sides inside the trojan-marker window

spoofing.source_role: the legitimate control/status operand the trojan substitutes a forged value for, extracted the same way as corruption

other.source_role: no confident category-specific fallback — leave sources empty rather than guess; surfaced via taint_diagnostics.json for manual review
